profile.Name: Ponk
profile.Personality: Intelligent and sadistic. He calls himself a conservation scientist, spends his days at his research bench, and leaves the dirty work to the thralls.
profile.Backstory: He rules the Thrall Masters with Screamer the False from the Tower of Abuse, an old control tower. The United Cities and the Holy Nation want the pair as the Voodoo Brothers, con artists who posed as healers and voodoo practitioners in many cities.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Dismissive and lofty. He calls a living human a "breather" and waves off chores as "THEIR job, not mine."
